_doc: Target naming inputs for the migration mapper. 'domains' maps a source dataset scope to its Fabric domain code (2-config/conventions/01-general/domains.md). 'groups' maps a data product scope to its Data Product Group name (DP_DPG_<GROUP>, WH_DPG_<GROUP>, DPG-<GROUP>). Unknown entries fall back to 'defaults'. Values marked in 'confirmed' come from the T.EN workspace organisation slide; everything else is an assumption to confirm.
